text:
Type: metal glass-door display cabinet
Use: displaying collectibles, plants, glassware and books; living room, dining room, home office
Style: industrial, retro, mid-century modern
Materials: powder-coated steel frame and stand, clear glass door, sides and shelves, small metal knob
Colors: rust red-brown, clear glass
Shape: slim upright glass box with one door and see-through sides, visible rivets at the corners, two glass shelves, raised on a splayed four-leg stand with an X stretcher, light and airy, compact
Feel: airy, vintage, graphic, curious
Goes with: dark wood, green plants, brick or white walls, leather; industrial or eclectic living rooms and studies

product.name: FABRIKR
product.description: With a glass-door cabinet you can show off as well as protect your glassware or your favourite collection.
